description: Show the dimensions of an OECD dataflow in key order, and (when you pass dimension) the codes of one dimension, optionally filtered by search text (e.g. dimension "REF_AREA", search "korea"). Use this to learn the codes before oecd_query. Reads the live published structure.

dimension.description: Dimension id to list codes for, e.g. REF_AREA, MEASURE, SECTOR

flow_ref.description: SDMX dataflow reference from list_curated_flows or search_dataflows

search.description: Case-insensitive text matched against code ids and names

name: oecd_describe_flow
title: Oecd Describe Flow
